The Jacobian singular values are |d_s| exp(-K +/- U); a direct Lyapunov diagonal difference proves persistent thermal nondegeneracy. The standalone package checker runs 6015 exact-rational and finite numerical assertions including independent integration; arbitrary-protocol truth rests on these explicit proofs, not experiments.

The complete answer uses only three scalar population data, dispenses with bath-temperature calibration, proves a sharp physical reachable set attained by constant controls, gives exact conditioning and classifies the sole observable degeneracy. These are exact structural and actionable limitations on inference for the entire physical control triangle, not an arbitrary numeric example or merely the standard covariance propagation identity.
